# Fluxer Fluxer is a free and open source instant messaging and VoIP chat app built for friends, groups, and communities.
readmeHtml:
Caution

As of this writing (15 June 2026), we are working to finalise the API and self-hosting documentation over the next few days.

We apologise for the brief delay in open-source releases. We paused after spam waves created safety concerns while we built out Fluxer's trust and safety infrastructure. During that same stretch, we have been fixing hundreds of bugs, adding new features, and preparing a much improved audio and video system.

You can already try that work in the Fluxer Canary client: download Canary or open Canary on the web. The latest stable client remains out of date for now, but over the coming weeks we are finalising the remaining work needed to stabilise the current latest code out in the open.

Note

Learn about the developer behind Fluxer, the goals of the project, the tech stack, and what's coming next.

Read the launch blog post | View full roadmap

Fluxer

Fluxer is a free and open source instant messaging and VoIP chat app built for friends, groups, and communities.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A privacy-focused, cross-platform media client currently in active beta development.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Fluxer is an alternative media client designed with a strong emphasis on user privacy, trust, and safety infrastructure. The application provides a clean interface for consuming media while stripping away invasive trackers and advertisements. Currently navigating a transition phase following spam issues, the development team is actively refining the core API, stabilizing self-hosting documentation, and overhauling the audio/video playback engine. Users can access the latest experimental features through the Fluxer Canary client while the stable version undergoes final stabilization.
keyFeatures: Privacy First: Designed from the ground up to protect user data and prevent invasive tracking.
Canary Release Channel: Provides access to cutting-edge experimental features via dedicated Canary clients.
Self-Hostable Architecture: Actively developing robust documentation and APIs for users to host their own instances.
Trust and Safety Infrastructure: Implements advanced mechanisms to mitigate spam and abuse on the platform.
Cross-Platform Availability: Offers both downloadable desktop clients and a web-based interface for easy access.

useCases.title: Spam-Resistant Communities
useCases.description: Leverage built-in trust and safety tools to build secure, abuse-free media sharing environments.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Fluxer is ideal for privacy advocates, early adopters, and self-hosting enthusiasts who want an alternative media consumption experience. It requires a willingness to use beta software while the stable version is finalized.
